title: Remove dashboard API-key frontend fallback for chat auth

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented frontend-scoped fix on clean branch/worktree codex/remove-api-key-frontend-fallback from origin/develop. Changes: extracted Amplify output resolution into dashboard/app/amplify-config.ts, removed non-local API-key override path from client layout, updated dev:web to stop requiring/exporting API key envs, removed API-key promotion in load-dev-env.sh, and updated console unauthorized banner wording to auth/session + Amplify target guidance.
